title: 6584: prevent pie chart crash on zero or negative values
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

This PR adds validation to handle negative values in pie charts:

- Prevents parser crashes caused by negative values by introducing validation during parsing.

- Provides clearer error messaging to guide users when invalid input is detected.

Resolves #6584

## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

#### Validation moved to the AST level:
Instead of rejecting values in the grammar, the parser accepts all numbers and performs validation during AST traversal. This allows more informative and user-friendly error messages.

comments.author: shubhamparikh2704
comments.body: Right now, the test only checks that some error is thrown. To make it more specific, please assert the actual error message so we can catch unintended error changes.

comments.author: sidharthv96
comments.body:
Why should we throw error on 0?
If someone is auto generating charts, there could be 0 values, which will be valuable to see in the legend. 
Let's throw error on -ve values, and show 0 on the legend.
